# create-chapter-transitions

Create short, polished chapter or section transition cards for videos, especially reference-matched kinetic typography with crisp live text, staged typing/reveal effects, coordinated sound design, and backgrounds that match an existing edit. Use when asked to make, recreate, revise, render, or insert a chapter transition, title card, section bumper, or interstitial between video scenes in HyperFrames or Borumi.

## Use

Ask your agent to use `$create-chapter-transitions`, or have it read [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) before starting the task.
